correctness.rationale: Two explicit simplicial homotopy pushouts. For rim deletion, full rim simplex glued to hub cone along I(P_n) yields its suspension. For spoke deletion, link I(P_{n-1}) union cone(A) reduces to the double suspension of I(P_{n-5}); a face-dimension bound nulls its attachment to the rim sphere. The recurrence I(P_m)~Sigma I(P_{m-3}) and the boundary case n=5 are proved. These give integral homotopy for every \(n\ge5\). A self-contained exact mod-2 chain verifier passed all 16 n/fault cases \(5\le n\le12\), as corroboration only.

value.rationale: A new complete spoke-fault classification, placed against the rim-fault type already accessible by the general join lemma, together giving the two natural single-edge-fault orbits across all wheel sizes \(n\ge5\), with a systematic contrast: spoke deletion retains the \(n-2\)-dimensional fundamental rim class and creates a periodic secondary sphere; rim deletion removes that class and gives a mod-three contractibility transition. A structural hub-link analysis explains the fault sensitivity, exceeding isolated numerics or intact-wheel corollaries.
